evidence.description: REQ-A1 + REQ-A2 close FIND-001: ANICCA_HOME resolved via git rev-parse --show-toplevel of script realpath; canonical install pinned to /Users/anicca/anicca; mismatch (e.g. ~/anicca-project) triggers non-zero exit with explicit stderr message.

REQ-A1 and REQ-A3 close FIND-002: both require literal '/Users/<uid>/...' absolute paths in the rendered plist and explicitly state '$HOME expanded at install-time, NOT a literal $HOME token'; REQ-A3 cites parent §3 L117-118.
REQ-E2 closes FIND-003: bounds detection to gui/<uid> domain via launchctl print, defines 4-step parse-trim-compare-bootout algorithm and the regex anchor for the path line.

REQ-A4 closes FIND-004: explicit ordering invariant 'Validation MUST run as the FIRST executable line after argument parsing, before any mkdir, file write, or subprocess invocation'; tri-clause (i)(ii)(iii) confirms no FS/launchctl side-effect on failure.

PROP-D1-no-human-touch-comprehensive closes FIND-005: extends grep across the .sh + Python helper + ANY imported module, denylists osascript/terminal-notifier/telegram/slack/twilio/find-generic-password/security add-generic-password/sudo/SecKeychain/outbound URLs (except localhost), plus runtime monkey-patch denial.
PROP-E1-cohealth-load-identity closes FIND-006: compares PID AND load-timestamp of <slot>-core-healthcheck BEFORE and AFTER; bootout-then-rebootstrap explicitly named as a failing case.

FIND-007 closed: purity boundary table designates lib/plist_render.py as the single PURE source; shell explicitly does NOT re-implement; PROP-NFR1-single-source-pure grep-bans validate_slot/render_plist/parse_loaded_plist_path keywords from the .sh and only permits 'python3 -m lib.plist_render' invocation.
PROP-A4-injection-guard-ordering operationalizes REQ-A4 via monkey-patched mkdir/launchctl fail-loud + slot='gig; rm -rf /' test, asserting validation surfaces before the side-effect failure.
